plan.title: Allow USD and INR bids with conversion

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Enable eRFX capabilities required by the scenario.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply an RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product and requested quantity.
Complete required pricing-sheet fields for the line item.
Verify the product's mapped variant is populated.
Set the requested delivery location.
Verify the requested quantity.

args.goal: on the buyer's RFQ create screen, open Add Bid Currencies, add USD with exchange rate 83, save it, and stop with the saved USD currency visible

steps.note: Configure the bid currency and exchange rate, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite two QA vendors for the scenario.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open this event's pricing round in the vendor portal.

args.need: select USD as the bid currency and submit a 1.2 USD quote for this event

steps.note: The vendor-side currency selection and exact USD submission are not supported by the catalog.
Confirm the vendor quote was accepted by the portal.
Return to the buyer's project page.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after the bid is submitted.
Verify the buyer sees the 1.2 USD bid converted at 83 to 99.6 INR.
